3.label: Short / likely low
3.text: Pandas and koalas are both animals, but pythons are snakes.
3.demo_note: Shows how a very short comparison response can look underdeveloped to the feature-based model.

3.label: Moderate
3.text: Pandas and koalas are similar because both are connected to one main place and both depend on a limited food source. They are different from pythons because pythons are reptiles that can live in many places and eat many different animals.
3.demo_note: Shows a more complete comparison with a clearer contrast.

3.label: Verbose but not necessarily correct
3.text: Pandas and koalas are very important and special animals because people care about them and because they have environments that affect their lives. Pythons are also important animals, but they are more dangerous and move differently, so this makes the comparison seem bigger and more serious overall.
3.demo_note: Useful for explaining that longer answers can earn a higher estimate even when the content support is not especially precise.
